voice_rules.register: Plain, confident language a busy owner could say across a counter.
voice_rules.confidence: State one concrete smallest-useful plan without rhetorical questions or hypothetical hedging.
voice_rules.effects: Every claimed effect names who benefits, when it happens, and what physically changes.
voice_rules.preservation: Name preserved tools, the person retaining decision authority, and workflow steps left untouched.
voice_rules.retelling: Use a sayable title and one memorable image; the situation, intervention, and payoff must survive a short spoken retelling.
voice_rules.breadcrumb: Website mode uses exactly one supported, warm business-specific detail; local mode uses none.
voice_rules.scope: Describe one proportional intervention inside Hearn Systems' software, AI, automation, integration, or data-work delivery envelope.
voice_rules.invitation: Invite a bounded conversation about this Spark in counter-level language, include the not-worth-changing exit, and apply no pressure.

claim_rules.local: Qualitative only: no pricing, ROI, percentages, invented counts, or business-specific assertions.
claim_rules.website: Business-specific claims and numbers must be supported by the supplied public-site evidence; no off-site or private evidence.
claim_rules.all: Do not turn absence, staleness, or breakage into an audit. Every observation must serve the constructive plan.

gate_boundary_examples.gate_3_pass: A bakery keeps its existing online order form while a small handoff adds a same-day sold-out update to the staff's current routine.
gate_boundary_examples.gate_3_fail: A new booking system replaces an existing scheduler that already performs the plan's core job.
gate_boundary_examples.gate_9_pass: A familiar missed-call routine gains one concrete after-hours capture step that is surprising but easy to picture.
gate_boundary_examples.gate_9_fail: Send ordinary seasonal reminders with no fresh intervention beyond common advice.
